newsitem.title: USA: Monsanto completes Calgene share tender.
newsitem.headline: Monsanto completes Calgene share tender.

text.p: Monsanto Co said Monday it completed its $8.00 a share cash tender offer to acquire shares of Calgene Inc that it did not already own.
Monsanto had announced in April that it reached a definitive agreement to acquire the shares for $8 each in a deal valued at about $240 million.

At the expiration of the tender on May 2, about 26.8 million shares were tendered, or about 88 percent of Calgene's outstanding shares, other than those owned by Monsanto. As a result, Monsanto and its affiliates now own about 94 percent of the outstanding Calgene shares.
Monsanto said it expects to complete the merger of Calgene shortly and to acquire the remaining shares at $8 each in cash.
Monsanto is a life-sciences company with operations in agriculture, pharmaceuticals and food ingredients.
